text:
ashok: quick heads-up — PR #8429 is blocked on architecture sign-off. adding the RFC here for context: https://redwood.ai/rfcs/2024-quant-routing :link: we need clearance before the friday release window

jess: thanks for the ping. what's the 2-line tl;dr of the risk/behavior change?

ashok: tl;dr: change routes certain realtime requests to a quantized variant when util > 70%. fallback goes to cpu-quantized model. perf risk is tail latency for 16k seq on small GPUs if kv-caching doesn't hit. rollout plan attached in PR.

liam: ok i'll take a look. can you call out SLO delta and the expected failure modes (and a short mitigation)? :eyes:

ashok: SLO delta: ~+20% p99 for affected path in worst-case synthetic load (staging). failure modes: cache-miss amplification -> tail spikes, or kernel fallback path overhead. mitigation: immediate fallback to cpu-quantized variant + circuit-breaker at 5% error increase. tests: unit + e2e present, staging run green.

jess: do we have automated canary gating (metric thresholds) in the rollout?

ashok: yes — canary automation will pause on: +5% p50 or +3% error rate. manual resume only after review. rollout steps in PR description.

liam: cool — i'll review post-standup and aim to leave an arch comment by 11:30. if i hit something blocking i'll ask for a tiny patch or a scoped fallback.

release-bot: Release window available: Friday 10:00-12:00 UTC — book via #eng-releases if you want the slot

kyle: if liam gives arch LGTM we'll merge and I can own the 3% canary and ops-run. tagging me when ready. :thumbsup:

ashok: thanks all — PR link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/8429 — ping @liam when you leave comments so i can address quickly

liam: noted. if all looks good i'll post `/arch-lgtm` in the PR and copy this thread. otherwise i'll leave inline comments.

jess: nice, thanks. please paste a 1-line summary of changes in the PR body for release notes before merge.

ashok: will do — adding release-note line now. :white_check_mark:
